🎥🎬: Mr. Irrelevant: The John Tuggle Story (2026)

John Tuggle is given a title that sounds like the ultimate dismissal—“Mr. Irrelevant.” Selected with the final pick of the NFL Draft, he enters professional football with something to prove and a lot of people expecting very little from him.

But Tuggle refuses to measure his potential by his draft position. He works, competes, and takes advantage of every opportunity to show that being chosen last doesn’t make him the least valuable.

His journey becomes a powerful underdog story about turning doubt into motivation and proving that one opportunity can change everything.

Release date: December 25, 2026
